question: A plane wavefront is incident obliquely on a boundary and passes into a medium where its speed is lower. Predict the change in wavelength and direction of the ray. Justify your answer.

options.A: The wavelength increases and the ray bends away from the normal because the speed in the second medium is lower.
options.B: The frequency remains unchanged on refraction. Since $v=f\lambda$, lower speed gives a smaller wavelength. Also, $\dfrac{\sin i}{\sin r}=\dfrac{v_1}{v_2}>1$, so $i>r$; the ray bends towards the normal.
options.C: The wavelength remains unchanged and the ray bends away from the normal because frequency decreases in the second medium.
options.D: The wavelength decreases, but the ray remains undeviated for oblique incidence.
